_meta.source: panel: VA of the call that adds the field; add_default: VA of the filler that writes it, 'editor-observed' (UIA), or 'unresolved'
_meta.field_keys: JSON key; flag checkboxes are key 'flags' with 'bit'. Fields are in panel order.
_meta.type: number = unranged number box (<input type=number step=any>, arrow keys/wheel +-1); slider = float slider (rzslider step 0.01, precision 2; |max-min|<0.5 would use sliderHighPrecision, step 0.001) with a free number box; sliderint = integer slider (step 1) with a free number box; checkbox; checkboxbit (one bit of 'flags'); vec2/vec3 = per-component number boxes (mode 'angle' shows degrees); color/hue = pickers (normalized: 0-1, else 0-255); colorlist = array-size slider + pickers; combo.
_meta.min/max: slider range from the panel call (immediates / float constants); null = no range
_meta.step: from scripts.js templates: 'any' for number boxes
_meta.clamp: false everywhere: no template sets min/max on the typed box and rzslider enforceRange is off; the editor never clamps a typed value
_meta.add_default: value the editor writes when the component is added (2D/orthographic scene); add_default_3d when the filler picks another value for a perspective scene (the filler flag is the same orthographic test the runtime uses)
_meta.condition: visibility expression evaluated by the panel (JS); the field is hidden, not removed, when false
_meta.editor_observed: UI Automation read of the WE editor (Windows session, particle_fields.json): every field it saw (327 values, 42 components) matches this table in order, value and option list; 'match' marks them.
